text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You know, when you come up against a
big wall, I
think it's perfectly fine to run
away at first.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It's not about getting there the fastest!
When
you're on the scenic route, there's
no telling what
cool ideas will pop into
your head!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
So anyway, I've been running away for
three days
now, but I still can't think of a
way out!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, what am I gonna do about
tomorrow's
quiz?
